rationale: APP gapped up ~29% on what appears to be a major catalyst, but the stock is now trading below session VWAP ($354.02) and sitting at only 43% of today's range after pulling back from the high of $365.33, suggesting the initial momentum has faded. With no clear directional edge and conflicting forces, the risk/reward does not justify a new position.
